title: Filter Occupied Intervals
summary: Given a 2D integer array occupiedIntervals, where each element is a time interval [starti, endi] indicating an occupied period, merge any overlapping or touching intervals.
statement: Given a 2D integer array occupiedIntervals, where each element is a time interval [starti, endi] indicating an occupied period, merge any overlapping or touching intervals. Then, remove all integer points within a specified free interval defined by freeStart and freeEnd. Return the remaining intervals in sorted order, ensuring they are non-overlapping and contain the minimum number of intervals possible. If no intervals remain, return an empty list.
constraints: Occupied intervals contain inclusive integer points.
First merge overlapping or touching intervals, then remove every point in the inclusive free interval.
Return the minimum sorted set of remaining non-touching intervals.
hints: Sort and merge intervals when the next start is at most previous end plus one.
For each merged interval, retain only portions strictly before and after the free range.
Clip the left remainder at freeStart-1 and the right at freeEnd+1.
Merging before subtraction guarantees the returned pieces are minimal and ordered.
editorial: Merging before subtraction guarantees the returned pieces are minimal and ordered.

tests.explanation: Merging then removing 7 through 11 leaves [2,6], [12,12], and [14,16].
The free interval removes every occupied point.
